cases.question: 按 Categories.CategoryName 计算 Products.UnitsInStock 库存合计，只返回库存合计大于所有类别库存合计平均值的类别及其合计。
cases.reference_sql_scoring_only: WITH g AS (SELECT c.CategoryName AS category,SUM(p.UnitsInStock) AS quantity FROM Products p JOIN Categories c ON p.CategoryID=c.CategoryID GROUP BY c.CategoryName) SELECT category,quantity FROM g WHERE quantity>(SELECT AVG(quantity) FROM g)
